# G2.3 Synthesis Fixtures

`discovery-synthesis-fixture.ts` extends the G2.2 synthetic runtime fixture with an explicit
retained-candidate fan-in, executable conversion v2 artifacts, solution-neutral Demand Thesis,
Baseline Option, Solution Hypothesis, Solution Evaluation, two Opportunity Thesis variants, an
immutable pre-enrichment snapshot, and a semantic merge result. Every value is marked synthetic;
the fixture performs no research and claims no Evidence truth, external validation, or validation
success.
